row.notes: (grid, layer, x, z, byte *valid, float *refHeight): x/z clamped to +-5000, floored; four corners (x0/x1, z0/z1) located via 0x14479ecc0 (tile, row, col) and read as u16 at grid+0xc88 + tile*0x8000 + row*0x100 + col*2 (0 = no data); height = grid+0x3f0a1c + u16 * grid+0x3f0a34. *valid = all four present and within 0.5 of the reference (refHeight, else the first present corner). Returns the bilinear blend. Callers 0x140158971, 0x14462f237, 0x14472119c. (lane owner review requested)
